title: Sources and licences
statement: NIGRAAN values are built from AGN’s own MACH weather stations, from national and partner observation networks (under data-sharing arrangements), and from the openly licensed datasets below. Glacial lakes and their status come from SUPARCO: its Glacier Geospatial Portal lake inventory and its published Space4Climate GLOF bulletins, credited by name; lakes SUPARCO does not hold come from the 2024 national glacial-lake inventory. Station calibration and river flood-warning limits come from national and partner observation networks under data-sharing arrangements. Values marked MACH-verified are measured by AGN's own MACH stations. Each open dataset is listed with its licence and the attribution its licence requires. Weather data are delivered through the MAch service.
